basis: Alkaline phosphatase deficiency causes severe skeletal hypomineralization and infantile rickets; respiratory compromise is largely secondary to skeletal disease.
CARD14-related psoriasis is an immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease; arthritis is a separate diagnosis.
Central and autonomic neurodegeneration; orthostasis and bladder dysfunction reflect neural failure rather than direct vascular or urinary tissue injury.
Defined embryofetopathy includes craniofacial skeletal abnormalities, nail dysplasia and neural tube defects; cardiac and cleft anomalies have uncertain frequencies.
Definition and ancestry describe familial CNS rhabdoid tumors; renal rhabdoid tumors occur in 1/2 annotated patients (~50%), although evidence is limited.
Developmental and psychomotor delay with hypotonia define the syndrome; growth restriction and facial appearance do not establish another damaged organ.
Allergic inflammation directly affects conjunctiva and cornea; other allergic diseases are separate conditions.
Factor V Amsterdam bleeding disorder is a coagulation protein disease; bleeding sites do not independently establish additional organ involvement.
Staphylococcal exfoliative toxins directly cause epidermal blistering and desquamation.
Congenital optic disc/optic nerve coloboma affects the eye; optic nerve abnormalities belong to the ocular axis here.
Inherited deficiency of an enzyme in tyrosine catabolism; no common additional organ damage is established by the supplied record.
GRIN2A-related epilepsy, intellectual disability and developmental impairment define a neurologic disorder; hypotonia does not establish primary muscle disease.
BCL10-related immunodeficiency; encephalitis is a separate infection. Colitis in one reported patient does not securely establish common intrinsic bowel involvement.
Umbrella skeletal dysplasia defined by severe growth deficiency and gracile, fracture-prone bones; neurologic and endocrine features vary across subtypes.
Glomerular dysfunction causes proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia and edema; immune causation does not apply to all nephrotic syndromes.
Pancreatic aplasia causes exocrine insufficiency (10/10) and diabetes (15/15), defining gastrointestinal and endocrine disease; isolated anemia/low Ig reports add no axis.
Defined by cerebral gigantism together with jaw cysts and basal cell naevoid syndrome, supporting brain, jaw bone and skin axes.
Tumor arises in bone; neural differentiation does not establish origin in or damage to the nervous system.
Zellweger spectrum commonly causes brain dysfunction, hepatopathy and retinal degeneration (each >30%); common hearing loss omitted because of the four-axis cap.
FASLG-associated autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome is defined by immune dysregulation and abnormal lymphocyte accumulation, including splenic involvement.
Familial compressive median neuropathy; tenosynovitis has no frequency supplied. TTR alone does not establish systemic amyloid organ involvement.
Absent gastric intrinsic factor causes B12 malabsorption and megaloblastic anemia; dementia/learning disability reported in 30-79% supports neurologic involvement.
Intestinal invagination causes bowel obstruction; ischemia, when present, remains within the gastrointestinal axis.
Neoplasm originates in the rectosigmoid region; lymphoma is only one possible histology and does not justify an immune label for the umbrella concept.
Altitude-induced instability of brainstem respiratory control causes sleep apnea; cardiovascular harm is a later risk rather than established common direct involvement.
